result.hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs2,592 cr (+35% YoY, +22% QoQ), EBITDA Rs554 cr (+159% YoY, margin 21% vs 11%), PAT Rs345 cr (+207% YoY); Phenolics EBIT Rs418 cr vs Rs118 cr a year ago (NSE 4 Aug and 11 Aug 2026 filings).

risk.cycle: HIGH: 75% of segment EBIT is phenolics; Q1 margin 21% vs 11% a year earlier is a spread spike tied to Middle East/Hormuz feedstock disruption

result.thesis: Reported inflection is real (Q1 FY27 EBITDA +159%, PAT +207%, record) but it is concentrated in Phenolics, whose EBIT rose from Rs118 cr to Rs418 cr YoY on spreads that management itself ties to feedstock/geopolitical disruption. FY26 revenue fell 4% and PAT was Rs551 cr, so only one quarter shows the new run-rate. At 27.8x TTM P/E the stock prices roughly half of the Q1 annualised earnings as sustainable; normalisation of phenol/acetone spreads is the key risk. New capacity (MIBK/MIBC, agro intermediates, polycarbonate) is a real but later catalyst. Not an early asymmetry.
chain_missing_links: Supply constraint is geopolitical/temporary, not structural
Persistence of Phenolics spreads beyond one quarter: unknown
Q1 FY27 CFO not in filings text; FY26 CFO/PAT 0.98
result.demand_signal: MANAGEMENT CLAIM: domestic demand stable across auto, infra, pharma, electronics; AI export demand strengthening in select markets; 86:14 domestic:export (FY26 Q4).
result.supply_signal: MANAGEMENT CLAIM: war in Middle East and Hormuz blockade disrupted feedstock/logistics; integrated domestic producers benefit. Temporary, not structural.
result.pricing_signal: FACT: EBITDA margin 21% vs 11% YoY and 18% QoQ; Phenolics EBIT margin ~24% of revenue vs 9% a year earlier (CALCULATION).
result.capacity_catalyst: MANAGEMENT CLAIM: multipurpose agro intermediates and MIBK/MIBC projects scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27 (Jul-Sep 2026); integrated polycarbonate project on track (Praxair HyCO on-site plant, BOO); Dahej nitration/hydrogenation ramped in FY26. Commissioning confirmation not yet seen in filings.
result.cfo_to_pat: 0.98 (FY26, dossier CALCULATION); receivables +18.2% vs revenue -4.1% in FY26, a mild flag; Q1 FY27 unknown
result.roce: EBITDA/invested capital 14.0%, ROE 9.4% on FY26 (dossier); Q1 annualised much higher
result.valuation: Mkt cap Rs21,802 cr, TTM P/E 27.8, EV/EBITDA 22.5. CALCULATION: Q1 annualised EPS ~Rs101 (25.3 x 4) gives ~16x at the peak quarter; FY26 EPS Rs40 gives ~40x. Price implies mid-cycle spreads roughly half-way between.

plausible.2x: NO: needs FY28 EPS ~Rs120+ at 27x, i.e. Q1 peak spreads held for two years plus new capacity.

kill_conditions: Phenolics EBIT falls below Rs250 cr/quarter for two quarters
EBITDA margin back below 15% in Q2 or Q3 FY27
MIBK/MIBC or agro intermediates commissioning slips beyond Q4 FY27
catalysts: Commissioning of MIBK/MIBC and agro intermediates
result.biggest_risk: Phenol/acetone spread normalisation after the geopolitical spike, collapsing the Phenolics profit pool.
result.next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 results: Phenolics EBIT and EBITDA margin vs Q1 21%, and commissioning of MIBK/MIBC.

bear.assumptions: Phenol spreads normalise to FY26 level (EPS ~Rs40); FY28 EPS 38; P/E 28x
